title: Say Panag-anap ed Korte
intro: Diad saray pasilyo na pakayari, sakey a too ya atagey so kipapasen to so nagmaliw ya inmabig ed sakey ya aripen ya say karakpan to et singa ed sananey a mundo. Sayan inka-inlove so angitonton ed nantutumbokan ya ebento ya manubok ed katooran, mangiparungtal na saray akaamot a katuaan, tan diad kaunoran et mamaneknek ed inka-inosente na aripen.
clues: Nanayam ak ed dalin na Nilo, diad sakey a palasyo a walaan na baleg ya impluensya.
Sakey a kalangweran a laki so linmoob ed sankaabungan ko, tan say kiwawala to so amawala na inkagulo na mundok.
Sinali kon palikdoen, balet sikatoy nananap na salimbengan ed Katawan to.
pinilat ko so kawes to manlapud beneg, balet say ebidensya so mangipapabitar ed panagpalikdo ko.
Pian nareen so tsismis na saray gagalangen a bibii, inimbitaan ko ran mantitipon tan inyan ko ray makdem a bengatla ed lima ra.
Diad sampot, impatua kod arap na ari so kasalanan ko, ya binidbir koy katwaan ed arap na ari.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Say asawa nen Al-Aziz
Asiya (Asawan Faraon)
Bilqis (Reyna na Sheba)
Maryam (Ina nen Isa)
Say Ina nen Musa

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Sinalik ya palikdoen si Propeta Yusuf
Sinalik ya pateyen si Propeta Musa
Inkuan ton sikatoy sakey a diosa
Nanggawa na tori pian labanan si Allah
Sikatoy angidaulo na armada sumpad Makkah
trial.answer: Sinalik ya palikdoen si Propeta Yusuf

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey a kamiseta ya apilat ed beneg
Sakey a balitok a kilaw a baka
Sakey a baston ya nagmaliw ya uleg

Sakey a lamparaan
location.answer: Sakey a kamiseta ya apilat ed beneg

options: Inamin to tan binidbir toy katuaan
Sikatoy linmereg a kaiba toy armada to
Nagmaliw ya lusek na asin

Sikatoy dineral na maksil a dagem
outcome.answer: Inamin to tan binidbir toy katuaan

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
